init_local_model_manager: initialize a LocalModelManager with a model name and optional GPU device ID
generate_response_with_text_prompt: generate a text response from a local VLM model using a text prompt
generate_response_with_image_prompt: generate a response from a local VLM model using text and image inputs
configure_model_loading: configure model loading with automatic GPU detection or explicit device assignment
review_local_model_manager: review the LocalModelManager class for loading and running local VLM models on GPU
